name: OmaClone
author: BlackCode
description: OmaClone: paste a git link, pick a folder, clone. Works with GitHub, Forgejo, Codeberg, GitLab, Gitea, Bitbucket, SourceHut and any git server; cleans up links copied from the browser and shows live progress

barWidget.description: Paste a git link and clone it into a folder you choose

schema.label: Default folder
schema.description: Where repositories go when you have not picked a folder. Empty: the folder you used last, else ~/Projects if it exists, else your home folder.

schema.label: After cloning
schema.description: What to do when a clone finishes. The buttons for all three are always on the finished card.
